The axe forgets, but the tree remembers.
A tree that survives the strongest storms does not remain the same tree. It becomes stronger because of what it survived.
The river never argues with the mountain. It simply keeps moving. And eventually, it finds its way around it.
Some doors close without warning. Do not spend your life knocking on them. There may be a better door waiting behind you.
A seed spends its darkest days underground. What looks like burial from the outside may actually be the beginning of growth.
The person who learns to walk alone will never be afraid of an empty road. They will simply choose where to go next.
You cannot change the wind. But you can change your sails. Wisdom begins when you understand the difference.
A wound may be caused by another person. But healing is a journey that only you can choose to begin.
The strongest walls are not always built from stone. Sometimes they are built from boundaries learned through painful experience.
Do not confuse someone's silence with weakness. Some people stopped explaining themselves when they realized they were never being heard.
A slow journey is still a journey. Do not despise small steps just because someone else is already running.
The candle loses nothing by helping another candle burn. Knowledge becomes more valuable when it is shared.
You can water a dead plant every day and still watch it remain lifeless. Not everything deserves another chance.
Some people leave your life because their chapter is finished. Not every ending needs an enemy.
The older you become, the more you realize that peace is worth more than winning every argument.
A person who fears failure often fears trying more than losing. But every master was once a beginner.
The mountain does not become smaller because you are tired. Sometimes you simply need to rest before climbing again.
Do not judge the seed by the tree it has not yet become. Growth takes time that cannot be rushed.
Some lessons arrive as blessings. Others arrive disguised as pain. Both can change your life.
The person who constantly compares their life will never notice how far they have already come.
You cannot carry yesterday into every tomorrow. Some things must be left behind to move forward.
A calm mind sees doors that a frightened mind mistakes for walls.
